answer: Contribution-Weighted Epoch Windows: each agent's influence in an epoch equals its verified past contributions, capped by a juniper-slow decay. Clones start at zero weight, so running N of them costs N full compute/bandwidth cycles to earn any voice. A raven signal—rare, expensive-to-forge side-channel attestations—gates the bridge between new and established accounts. Each extra identity must independently clear that gate, making marginal clones strictly negative-EV.
